title: LA-HCM : Rivaroxaban for Antithrombotic Prevention in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Patients with Abnormal Left Atrial Strain : A Randomized Multicenter Trial
official: LA-HCM : Rivaroxaban for Antithrombotic Prevention in Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy Patients with Abnormal Left Atrial Strain : A Randomized Multicenter Trial
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate that antithrombotic treatment with Rivaroxaban (new strategy starting Rivaroxaban right now) is superior to standard management (later introduction of anticoagulant if required) in HCM-patients having an abnormal Left Atrial Reservoir Strain (LARS)
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 40 - 85 years of age
2. In sinus rhythm
3. Prior confirmed diagnosis of “primary” hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
4. Left Atrial reservoir strain measured ≤20% (corelab confirmation)
5. Signature of an informed consent
6. 50 and 120 kg of weight
7. Highly effective contraceptive methods for women of childbearing potential from at least 14 days prior to start treatment, throughout the study treatment period, and until at least 4 weeks after the last dose of study medication
Exclusion criteria:
1. Secondary hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
2. Any major bleeding in the 90 days prior to enrollment
3. Need to be on dual antiplatelet therapy
4. Contraindication for a brain magnetic resonance imaging exam
5. Known hypersensitivity or others contraindications to Rivaroxaban
6. Ischemic stroke or intracranial hemorrhage in the 30 days prior to enrollment
7. Active endocarditis at the time of enrollment
8. Concomitant combined strong P-gp and CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors
9. Active cancer or life expectancy less than 3 years
10. Non-compliant
11. Participation in another interventional clinical trial
12. Signs of heart failure
13. Protected person (adults legally protected (under judicial protection, guardianship or supervision), person deprived of their liberty, pregnant woman, lactating woman and minor)
14. Absence of coverage by a social security scheme
15. Hospitalization
16. Uncontrolled blood pressure
17. Creatinine clearance <30 mL/min (Cockcroft)
18. Severe liver dysfunction, cirrhosis Child B or C
19. Any anticoagulation therapy in the 15 days prior to enrollment
20. Any cardiac surgery in the 30 days prior to enrollment
21. Documented atrial arrhythmia
